newsitem.title: PANAMA: Mobil to develop Panama bunker fuel site.
newsitem.headline: Mobil to develop Panama bunker fuel site.

text.p: Mobil Oil Corp and Saudi Arabian firm Alireza will pump $25 million into a U.S. naval station in Panama to develop a bunker fuel distribution center, a government spokeswoman said.
Operations will begin in 90 days by the local unit of the alliance, Alireza-Mobil Terminal SAu, a Regional Interoceanic Authority (ARI) spokesman said.
ARI is the government body in charge of attracting investment on military installations in Panama to be vacated by the United States, in accordance with bilateral treaties.

The center will be located on an 806-acre (326-hectare) portion of Rodman Naval Station which was turned over to Panamanian control on Wednesday. The entire station, which is in U.S. hands, is due to be turned over by 1999.
Alireza-Mobil signed a 20-year renewable contract with ARI to develop the center, located at Panama Canal's Pacific entrance, provide services and sell bunker fuel to transiting ships.
